title: Resolve Java var types through cross-file receiver method calls
wanted_capability: methodRegions should provide resolved_type for Java var declarations initialized by a method call on a captured field or dependency when the callee return type can be found in the same project, so extract-method probes do not manually search callee declarations.
missing_primitive: Project-index-backed Java var RHS return-type resolution for receiver method calls
fallback_used: Probe agent manually searched for the callee declaration and copied the declared return type into explicit helper parameters.
notes: Generic finding from a private Java calculation-stage reprobe. The previously added same-file method-call inference is useful but not enough for dependency/field receiver calls whose declarations live elsewhere in the project.
